exclusion_reason: No browser frame or audio bridge exists yet, so a full-motion-video middleware path has nothing to decode into and no synchronization has been measured.
promotion_trigger: Promote when a supported Bink, Smacker, and VP6 clip decodes and presents in sync through the browser frame and audio, and a proprietary WMV or Indeo bitstream is refused.
expected_failing_assertion: The full-motion-video suite cannot decode and present a supported clip in audio-video sync.
active_gate_evidence: The product identifies a full-motion-video middleware signal and reports the decode plan without decoding or presenting a frame.
procedure: Decode a supported Bink, Smacker, and VP6 fixture and present it through the browser frame and audio.
Measure audio-video synchronization and refuse a proprietary WMV or Indeo bitstream.
pass_criterion: Each supported clip decodes and presents within the declared synchronization tolerance.
An unsupported proprietary bitstream is refused rather than mis-decoded.
